newsitem.title: CHINA: China not to change 400 T level of gold reserves.
newsitem.headline: China not to change 400 T level of gold reserves.

text.p: China will make no changes at present to the size of its gold reserves, which currently stand at about 400 tonnes, the China Securities on Wednesday quoted a central bank official as saying.
"For the present, there will be no adjustment," the newspaper quoted the unidentified official as saying.
China's gold reserves stood at about 400 tonnes, or some 12.7 million ounces, he said.
China produced about 60 tonnes of gold in the first half of this year.
China turned out just over 120 tonnes of gold in 1996 and said it plans to raise output to about 130 tonnes this year.
It rarely comments on the size of its gold reserves.
